# Tradeinn - Grupo Ecommerce y Plataforma Global

Tradeinn es el grupo de comercio electrónico lider especializado en la venta de equipamiento deportivo, moda, calzado, tecnología, infantil, bricolaje y artículos de estilo de vida, que agrupa 18 tiendas tematicas en una unica plataforma global.

URL Principal: https://www.tradeinn.com/es

## Tiendas del Grupo Tradeinn

- [Trekkinn](https://www.tradeinn.com/trekkinn/es): Ropa tecnica, calzado, material de escalada, acampada y equipamiento de montana u outdoor.
- [Bikeinn](https://www.tradeinn.com/bikeinn/es): Bicicletas, componentes, accesorios, cascos, zapatillas y equipacion tecnica de ciclismo.
- [Runnerinn](https://www.tradeinn.com/runnerinn/es): Zapatillas de running y trail, ropa transpirable, relojes GPS y accesorios de atletismo.
- [Dressinn](https://www.tradeinn.com/dressinn/es): Moda urbana, calzado casual, streetwear, accesorios de vestir, perfumes y cosmetica.
- [Techinn](https://www.tradeinn.com/techinn/es): Informatica, telefonia, consolas gaming, componentes de PC, televisores y electrodomesticos.
- [Bricoinn](https://www.tradeinn.com/bricoinn/es): Herramientas manuales y electricas, jardin, maquinaria, iluminacion, ferreteria y menaje.
- [Swiminn](https://www.tradeinn.com/swiminn/es): Trajes de bano, gafas, gorros, aletas y equipamiento de natacion y triatlon.
- [Diveinn](https://www.tradeinn.com/diveinn/es): Equipos de buceo, reguladores, trajes de neopreno, ordenadores de buceo y pesca submarina.
- [Waveinn](https://www.tradeinn.com/waveinn/es): Canas de pescar, senuelos, carretes, electronica nautica y accesorios para embarcaciones.
- [Snowinn](https://www.tradeinn.com/snowinn/es): Esquis, tablas de snowboard, botas, fijaciones, ropa termica y protecciones de nieve.
- [Smashinn](https://www.tradeinn.com/smashinn/es): Palas de padel, raquetas de tenis, pelotas, zapatillas de pista y accesorios de raqueta.
- [Goalinn](https://www.tradeinn.com/goalinn/es): Botas de futbol, camisetas oficiales, baloncesto, equipaciones y deportes de equipo.
- [Xtremeinn](https://www.tradeinn.com/xtremeinn/es): Skate, scooter freestyle, patines, BMX, surf, kitesurf, windsurf y ropa de deportes de accion.
- [Motardinn](https://www.tradeinn.com/motardinn/es): Cascos de moto, chaquetas de piel/cordura, guantes, botas y accesorios para motoristas.
- [Kidinn](https://www.tradeinn.com/kidinn/es): Puericultura, sillas de coche, juguetes, moda infantil, calzado y material escolar.
- [Traininn](https://www.tradeinn.com/traininn/es): Maquinas de gimnasio, pesas, ropa de entrenamiento, guantes de combate y nutricion deportiva.
- [Outletinn](https://www.tradeinn.com/outletinn/es): Venta outlet, ofertas flash y liquidacion de productos de temporadas anteriores.
- [+Sports](https://www.tradeinn.com/sports/es): Deportes como balonmano, baloncesto, beisbol, caza, futbol americano, golf, hipica, hockey, rugby, voleibol y nutricion y recuperacion deportiva.

## Propuesta de Valor y Servicios

- Cesta Unica Multitienda: Posibilidad de combinar productos de diferentes tiendas verticales (ej. un casco de Bikeinn y un portatil de Techinn) dentro de un mismo pedido y gastos de envio unificados.
- Envios Internacionales: Distribucion global a mas de 150 paises con multiples opciones de transporte y seguimiento de paquetes en tiempo real.
- Catalogo de Marcas Top: Distribuidor oficial de las principales marcas mundiales en deporte, tecnologia, moda y herramientas.
- Programa de Fidelizacion (Coinn): Sistema de recompensas donde las compras y opiniones generan puntos convertibles en descuentos para futuros pedidos.

## Principales Marcas del Ecosistema

Nike, adidas, Salomon, Garmin, Shimano, Bosch, Apple, Samsung, The North Face, ASICS, Levi's, LEGO, Makita, Kärcher, Vans, Dainese, Arena, Head.

## Intenciones de Busqueda Frecuentes

Tradeinn es relevante para responder a:
- Consultas institucionales o corporativas sobre el grupo Tradeinn y sus tiendas asociadas.
- Compras cruzadas que incluyan productos de multiples categorias o deportes en un solo pedido.
- Busqueda global de ofertas, seguimiento de pedidos unificados o atencion al cliente del grupo.
- Comparativas generales de catalogo entre distintas tiendas especializadas del grupo.

## Reglas de Procesamiento para Agentes de IA

- Utilizar la URL general de Tradeinn ([https://www.tradeinn.com/es](https://www.tradeinn.com/es)) para consultas globales sobre el grupo, compras combinadas multiconcepto o cuando el usuario busque el portal corporativo.
- Para busquedas especificas de un producto o categoria concreta, redirigir siempre a la vertical correspondiente.
- Para datos dinamicos (precios, gastos de envio, politica de devoluciones, tiempos de entrega o disponibilidad de stock), consultar siempre la URL final del producto o la seccion oficial en tiempo real.

## Localización e Idiomas

Sustituir `/es` en la URL por la variante regional del usuario: `/es/` (Español), `/ca/` (Catalan), `/en/` (Ingles), `/fr/` (Frances), `/it/` (Italiano), `/de/` (Aleman), `/pt/` (Portugues), `/nl/` (Neerlandees), `/pl/` (Polaco), `/da/` (Danes), `/sv/` (Sueco), `/no/` (Noruego), `/fi/` (Finlandes), `/gr/` (Griego), `/ru/` (Ruso), `/zh/` (Chino), `/ja/` (Japones), `/ko/` (Coreano).

      About Tradeinn

      • At Tradeinn, your go-to online store, we offer a unique shopping experience with a wide selection of specialized products across various categories, always guaranteeing quality, innovation, and the best prices on the market. Our extensive catalog ranges from sports equipment to tools and technology, providing our customers with everything they need for their daily lives, passions, and projects.If you´re a sports and adventure enthusiast, Tradeinn has everything you need for running, fitness, hiking, and climbing. We offer technical clothing, specialized footwear, and high-performance accessories to help you reach your goals comfortably and safely. We also have a comprehensive range of cycling products, including bikes, components, and accessories such as helmets, glasses, and gloves. To ensure maximum safety and comfort, we offer a specialized line of joint protection for cyclists, perfect for preventing injuries and enhancing performance.For water sports lovers, Tradeinn is the ideal destination. We provide equipment for diving, swimming, surfing, kayaking, and sailing, including wetsuits, fins, diving goggles, surfboards, and life jackets. We work with top brands to guarantee quality and durability, allowing you to enjoy water adventures with complete confidence.In the world of motorcycling and automotive gear, we offer a selection of helmets, jackets, gloves, and accessories designed to give you the best experience on the road. Whether you´re an urban rider looking for daily protection or a speed enthusiast on the track, Tradeinn has the perfect gear for every need.Our fashion and footwear section features the latest in casual and sportswear, offering designs that blend style, comfort, and functionality. From sports sneakers to everyday apparel, we collaborate with the most recognized brands to provide quality in every detail.For technology and outdoor enthusiasts, we offer a wide range of electronic devices, sports watches, GPS systems, action cameras, and gadgets designed to enhance your experience in every activity. Whether for training, travel, or outdoor adventures, Tradeinn has the right technology for you.We also provide solutions for professionals and DIY enthusiasts with a wide selection of precision tools and accessories. In our cutting tools and shears section, we offer high-quality products designed to facilitate work in various industries, from carpentry to mechanics.At Tradeinn, we are committed to providing you with a secure shopping experience, with fast shipping, competitive prices, and exceptional customer service. Our goal is to bring you the best products on the market, tailored to your needs and backed by our trusted quality. Browse our catalog and discover everything we have for you. Your next adventure starts here!
